nowSource: Source: MFL fantasy points, this league's scoring · no finished week held yet
dynastySource: Source: the Lab's value model · not compiled yet
how: On-field-now is points per game in this league's scoring over the finished weeks MFL has scored, counting only weeks in which the player has a score, ranked against every player at his position with a score this season. Dynasty value is the Lab's forecast of the wins he adds over five seasons (this season's unplayed weeks and the four after), later seasons discounted; market is what the league has paid for that in trades, in win-equivalents (1.00 is the price of one expected win from a next-draft first-round pick), with the market's 95% range. Each player in a trade also costs a roster spot, so filler can price below zero. Values only; this app moves nothing.
